title: TraceLens · Incident Brief

options.content:
### How to read this page

Work from the top down. Each section answers one question.

| Section | Question it answers |
| --- | --- |
| **Most likely cause** | What is broken, and how much should I trust that? |
| **Right now** | Is the incident still live? Is TraceLens still receiving data? |
| **What to do next** | Which reviewed steps should I follow? TraceLens never runs them for you. |
| **Suspects and evidence** | What else could it be, and what argues for and against the top suspect? |
| **How it spread** | Who went wrong first, and where do the suspects sit in the system? |
| **Detailed charts / TraceLens health** | Raw signals for deeper digging, and the platform's own health. |
| **Trace waterfall** (link at the top right, or click a suspect) | How did one request move through the services, span by span? |

**Colour means one thing.** Red needs action, amber means check this, green is healthy, blue is something you can click, grey means no signal.

**Trust levels.** *Strong*: evidence agrees, start with the runbook. *Likely*: best lead, but check the next suspect. *Weak lead*: only if the top suspects are ruled out. *Inconclusive*: investigate by hand with the timeline.

The **ranking score** compares suspects with each other. It is not the same as trust: a suspect can score 99% and still only be *Likely*.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), inc AS (SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM selected)), top AS (SELECT * FROM candidate_rankings WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) ORDER BY rank LIMIT 1), onset AS (SELECT candidate_id, min(value) AS delay FROM evidence_items WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) AND evidence_type = 'temporal_precedence' GROUP BY candidate_id), cov AS (SELECT candidate_id, max(value) AS coverage FROM evidence_items WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) AND evidence_type = 'topology_propagation' GROUP BY candidate_id), ranked AS (SELECT cr.id, cr.rank, cr.entity_id, cr.confidence, o.delay, c.coverage FROM candidate_rankings cr LEFT JOIN onset o ON o.candidate_id = cr.id LEFT JOIN cov c ON c.candidate_id = cr.id WHERE cr.incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) AND cr.rank <= 3), lead AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rank = 1), rival AS (SELECT r.* FROM ranked r, lead l WHERE r.rank > 1 AND r.delay IS NOT NULL AND r.delay < COALESCE(l.delay, 0) ORDER BY r.rank LIMIT 1), health AS (SELECT value AS error_rate, (details->>'latency_ms_p95')::double precision AS p95 FROM evidence_items WHERE candidate_id = (SELECT id FROM top) AND evidence_type = 'dependency_health' ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 1), sig AS (SELECT value AS p95 FROM evidence_items WHERE candidate_id = (SELECT id FROM top) AND signal_name = 'latency_ms_p95' ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 1), fb AS (SELECT fb.error_rate, fb.latency_ms_p95 FROM feature_buckets fb, inc WHERE fb.entity_id = (SELECT entity_id FROM top) AND fb.bucket_start >= inc.started_at ORDER BY fb.bucket_start DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT id FROM inc) IS NULL THEN 'No incident selected' WHEN t.id IS NULL THEN 'Waiting for the ranking' WHEN t.entity_type = 'dependency_edge' AND t.fault_class = 'dependency_unreachable' THEN split_part(t.entity_id, '->', 1) || ' can''t reliably reach ' || split_part(t.entity_id, '->', 2) WHEN t.entity_type = 'no_fault' THEN 'No single cause stands out' ELSE replace(t.entity_id, '->', ' → ') || ' ' || CASE t.fault_class WHEN 'dependency_unreachable' THEN 'can''t reach a dependency' WHEN 'queue_lag' THEN 'is falling behind on its queue' WHEN 'workload_spike' THEN 'is under a traffic spike' WHEN 'cache_failure' THEN 'has a failing cache' ELSE 'is ' || lower(CASE t.fault_class WHEN 'dependency_unreachable' THEN 'Can''t reach a dependency' WHEN 'service_error' THEN 'Returning errors' WHEN 'conditional_service_error' THEN 'Returning errors for some requests' WHEN 'resource_saturation' THEN 'Running out of capacity' WHEN 'queue_lag' THEN 'Queue falling behind' WHEN 'database_lock' THEN 'Stuck on database locks' WHEN 'workload_spike' THEN 'Traffic spike' WHEN 'cache_failure' THEN 'Cache failing' WHEN 'memory_leak' THEN 'Leaking memory' WHEN 'garbage_collection_pause' THEN 'Pausing for garbage collection' WHEN 'readiness_failure' THEN 'Failing health checks' WHEN 'dependency_latency' THEN 'Slow to answer' WHEN 'conditional_dependency_latency' THEN 'Slow for some requests' WHEN 'no_fault' THEN 'No fault' ELSE initcap(replace(COALESCE(t.fault_class, 'unknown'), '_', ' ')) END) END END AS headline, CASE WHEN t.id IS NULL THEN 'Suspects are scored shortly after an incident opens.' ELSE CASE t.entity_type WHEN 'dependency_edge' THEN 'Connection' WHEN 'service' THEN 'Service' WHEN 'service_instance' THEN 'Instance' WHEN 'database' THEN 'Database' WHEN 'queue' THEN 'Queue' WHEN 'cache' THEN 'Cache' WHEN 'host' THEN 'Host' WHEN 'external' THEN 'Outside load' WHEN 'no_fault' THEN 'No fault' ELSE initcap(replace(t.entity_type, '_', ' ')) END || ' · failure type: ' || lower(CASE t.fault_class WHEN 'dependency_unreachable' THEN 'Can''t reach a dependency' WHEN 'service_error' THEN 'Returning errors' WHEN 'conditional_service_error' THEN 'Returning errors for some requests' WHEN 'resource_saturation' THEN 'Running out of capacity' WHEN 'queue_lag' THEN 'Queue falling behind' WHEN 'database_lock' THEN 'Stuck on database locks' WHEN 'workload_spike' THEN 'Traffic spike' WHEN 'cache_failure' THEN 'Cache failing' WHEN 'memory_leak' THEN 'Leaking memory' WHEN 'garbage_collection_pause' THEN 'Pausing for garbage collection' WHEN 'readiness_failure' THEN 'Failing health checks' WHEN 'dependency_latency' THEN 'Slow to answer' WHEN 'conditional_dependency_latency' THEN 'Slow for some requests' WHEN 'no_fault' THEN 'No fault' ELSE initcap(replace(COALESCE(t.fault_class, 'unknown'), '_', ' ')) END) || ' · ranking score ' || round((100 * COALESCE(t.probability, t.score))::numeric, 1)::text || '% · scored by ' || split_part(t.model_version, '-sha256', 1) END AS detail, CASE t.confidence WHEN 'high' THEN 'STRONG · START WITH THE RUNBOOK' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'LIKELY · TREAT AS A LEAD' WHEN 'low' THEN 'WEAK LEAD · INVESTIGATE BY HAND' ELSE 'INCONCLUSIVE' END AS trust, COALESCE((SELECT error_rate FROM health), (SELECT error_rate FROM fb)) AS calls_failing, COALESCE((SELECT p95 FROM health), (SELECT p95 FROM sig), (SELECT latency_ms_p95 FROM fb)) AS p95_ms, extract(epoch FROM (SELECT started_at FROM inc) + make_interval(secs => COALESCE((SELECT delay FROM lead), 0))) * 1000 AS went_bad_at, CASE WHEN (SELECT delay FROM lead) IS NULL THEN 'Onset not measured' WHEN (SELECT delay FROM lead) = 0 THEN 'Among the first to change' ELSE CASE WHEN ((SELECT delay FROM lead)) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ((SELECT delay FROM lead)) < 60 THEN round((SELECT delay FROM lead))::text || ' s' WHEN ((SELECT delay FROM lead)) < 3600 THEN floor(((SELECT delay FROM lead)) / 60)::text || ' min ' || round(mod(((SELECT delay FROM lead))::numeric, 60))::text || ' s' WHEN ((SELECT delay FROM lead)) < 86400 THEN floor(((SELECT delay FROM lead)) / 3600)::text || ' h ' || floor(mod(((SELECT delay FROM lead))::numeric, 3600) / 60)::text || ' min' ELSE floor(((SELECT delay FROM lead)) / 86400)::text || ' days' END || ' after the first anomaly' END AS after_first, CASE WHEN t.id IS NULL THEN 'Nothing to check yet.' WHEN t.confidence = 'low' THEN 'Weak evidence for every suspect. Use the timeline below and treat the list as leads.' WHEN (SELECT id FROM rival) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Check suspect #' || (SELECT rank FROM rival) || ' (' || replace((SELECT entity_id FROM rival), '->', ' → ') || ') before acting. It started ' || CASE WHEN ((SELECT delay FROM lead) - (SELECT delay FROM rival)) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ((SELECT delay FROM lead) - (SELECT delay FROM rival)) < 60 THEN round((SELECT delay FROM lead) - (SELECT delay FROM rival))::text || ' s' WHEN ((SELECT delay FROM lead) - (SELECT delay FROM rival)) < 3600 THEN floor(((SELECT delay FROM lead) - (SELECT delay FROM rival)) / 60)::text || ' min ' || round(mod(((SELECT delay FROM lead) - (SELECT delay FROM rival))::numeric, 60))::text || ' s' WHEN ((SELECT delay FROM lead) - (SELECT delay FROM rival)) < 86400 THEN floor(((SELECT delay FROM lead) - (SELECT delay FROM rival)) / 3600)::text || ' h ' || floor(mod(((SELECT delay FROM lead) - (SELECT delay FROM rival))::numeric, 3600) / 60)::text || ' min' ELSE floor(((SELECT delay FROM lead) - (SELECT delay FROM rival)) / 86400)::text || ' days' END || ' earlier' || CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT coverage FROM rival), 0) > COALESCE((SELECT coverage FROM lead), 0) THEN ' and explains more of the spread (' || round(100 * (SELECT coverage FROM rival))::text || '% vs ' || round(100 * COALESCE((SELECT coverage FROM lead), 0))::text || '%)' ELSE '' END || '. The top suspect may be a victim.' ELSE 'Evidence agrees: no higher-ranked rival changed before the top suspect.' END AS headsup, CASE WHEN t.id IS NULL OR t.confidence = 'low' OR (SELECT id FROM rival) IS NOT NULL THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END AS headsup_level FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN top t ON true

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), inc AS (SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM selected)), top AS (SELECT * FROM candidate_rankings WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) ORDER BY rank LIMIT 1), seen AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT fb.entity_id) AS n FROM feature_buckets fb, inc WHERE fb.entity_type <> 'dependency_edge' AND fb.bucket_start BETWEEN inc.started_at - interval '5 minutes' AND COALESCE(inc.ended_at, now())), fresh AS (SELECT max(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - latest_at))) AS age FROM v_telemetry_ingest_health WHERE signal IN ('spans', 'metrics', 'logs')), others AS (SELECT count(*) AS open_n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE detected_at < now() - interval '1 day') AS stale_n FROM incidents WHERE status IN ('open', 'monitoring') AND id <> (SELECT id FROM selected)) SELECT state, what, value, detail FROM (SELECT 1 AS ord, CASE WHEN i.status IN ('open', 'monitoring') AND i.severity = 'critical' THEN 'bad' WHEN i.status IN ('open', 'monitoring') THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END AS state, 'Status' AS what, initcap(i.status) || ' · ' || i.severity AS value, 'Detected ' || CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - i.detected_at)) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - i.detected_at)) < 60 THEN round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - i.detected_at))::text || ' s' WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - i.detected_at)) < 3600 THEN floor((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - i.detected_at)) / 60)::text || ' min ' || round(mod((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - i.detected_at))::numeric, 60))::text || ' s' WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - i.detected_at)) < 86400 THEN floor((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - i.detected_at)) / 3600)::text || ' h ' || floor(mod((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - i.detected_at))::numeric, 3600) / 60)::text || ' min' ELSE floor((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - i.detected_at)) / 86400)::text || ' days' END || ' ago' || CASE WHEN i.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN ', lasted ' || CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM i.ended_at - i.started_at)) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM i.ended_at - i.started_at)) < 60 THEN round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM i.ended_at - i.started_at))::text || ' s' WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM i.ended_at - i.started_at)) < 3600 THEN floor((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM i.ended_at - i.started_at)) / 60)::text || ' min ' || round(mod((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM i.ended_at - i.started_at))::numeric, 60))::text || ' s' WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM i.ended_at - i.started_at)) < 86400 THEN floor((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM i.ended_at - i.started_at)) / 3600)::text || ' h ' || floor(mod((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM i.ended_at - i.started_at))::numeric, 3600) / 60)::text || ' min' ELSE floor((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM i.ended_at - i.started_at)) / 86400)::text || ' days' END ELSE '' END AS detail FROM inc i UNION ALL SELECT 2, CASE WHEN cardinality(i.affected_entities) > 0.5 * GREATEST((SELECT n FROM seen), 1) THEN 'bad' ELSE 'warn' END, 'Affected', cardinality(i.affected_entities)::text || ' of ' || GREATEST((SELECT n FROM seen), cardinality(i.affected_entities))::text || ' components', CASE WHEN cardinality(i.affected_entities) > 0.5 * GREATEST((SELECT n FROM seen), 1) THEN 'More than half the system shows symptoms' ELSE 'Symptoms are contained to part of the system' END FROM inc i UNION ALL SELECT 3, CASE WHEN (SELECT age FROM fresh) < 60 THEN 'ok' WHEN (SELECT age FROM fresh) < 300 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'bad' END, 'Data arriving', CASE WHEN (SELECT age FROM fresh) < 60 THEN 'Fresh · ' ELSE 'Stale · ' END || CASE WHEN (SELECT age FROM fresh) < 10 THEN round((SELECT age FROM fresh)::numeric, 1)::text || ' s' ELSE CASE WHEN ((SELECT age FROM fresh)) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ((SELECT age FROM fresh)) < 60 THEN round((SELECT age FROM fresh))::text || ' s' WHEN ((SELECT age FROM fresh)) < 3600 THEN floor(((SELECT age FROM fresh)) / 60)::text || ' min ' || round(mod(((SELECT age FROM fresh))::numeric, 60))::text || ' s' WHEN ((SELECT age FROM fresh)) < 86400 THEN floor(((SELECT age FROM fresh)) / 3600)::text || ' h ' || floor(mod(((SELECT age FROM fresh))::numeric, 3600) / 60)::text || ' min' ELSE floor(((SELECT age FROM fresh)) / 86400)::text || ' days' END END || ' old', 'Newest span, metric and log all checked' UNION ALL SELECT 4, CASE WHEN (SELECT stale_n FROM others) > 0 THEN 'warn' WHEN (SELECT open_n FROM others) > 0 THEN 'bad' ELSE 'ok' END, 'Other open incidents', CASE WHEN (SELECT open_n FROM others) = 0 THEN 'None' ELSE (SELECT open_n FROM others)::text END, CASE WHEN (SELECT stale_n FROM others) > 0 THEN (SELECT stale_n FROM others)::text || ' open for over a day. Review or resolve them' WHEN (SELECT open_n FROM others) > 0 THEN 'Pick them from the Incident menu above' ELSE 'This is the only live incident' END UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'info', 'Ranking model', COALESCE(split_part((SELECT model_version FROM top), '-sha256', 1), 'Not scored yet'), 'Falls back to heuristic-v1 if the model cannot load') x ORDER BY ord

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), rec AS (SELECT rb.title, rb.description, rb.version, rb.diagnostic_steps, rb.remediation_steps, rb.verification_steps, rb.rollback_steps, cr.rank, cr.entity_id FROM recommendations r JOIN runbooks rb ON rb.id = r.runbook_id LEFT JOIN candidate_rankings cr ON cr.id = r.candidate_id WHERE r.incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) ORDER BY cr.rank NULLS LAST, r.compatibility_score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT phase, step_no, step FROM (SELECT 0 AS ord, 'Runbook' AS phase, NULL::bigint AS step_no, rec.title || ' (v' || rec.version || ') for suspect #' || COALESCE(rec.rank::text, '?') || ', ' || replace(COALESCE(rec.entity_id, 'unknown'), '->', ' → ') || '. ' || rec.description AS step FROM rec UNION ALL SELECT 1, 'Diagnose', s.n, s.step FROM rec, jsonb_array_elements_text(rec.diagnostic_steps) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(step, n) UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Fix', s.n, s.step FROM rec, jsonb_array_elements_text(rec.remediation_steps) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(step, n) UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Verify', s.n, s.step FROM rec, jsonb_array_elements_text(rec.verification_steps) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(step, n) UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Roll back', s.n, s.step FROM rec, jsonb_array_elements_text(rec.rollback_steps) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(step, n)) x ORDER BY ord, step_no

panels.description: Feedback is stored for evaluation. It does not change this result or retrain the model.
panels.title: Was this diagnosis right?

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id) SELECT COALESCE(verdict, CASE WHEN accepted THEN 'correct' WHEN accepted = false THEN 'incorrect' ELSE 'unsure' END) AS verdict, comment, COALESCE(replace(actual_entity_id, '->', ' → '), '') AS real_cause, user_name AS reviewer, created_at AS submitted FROM developer_feedback WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) UNION ALL SELECT 'none', 'No feedback yet. Record it with POST /api/v1/incidents/{id}/feedback; the link icon on this panel opens the API docs.', NULL, NULL, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM developer_feedback WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected)) ORDER BY submitted DESC NULLS LAST

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), onset AS (SELECT candidate_id, min(value) AS delay FROM evidence_items WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) AND evidence_type = 'temporal_precedence' GROUP BY candidate_id) SELECT cr.rank, replace(cr.entity_id, '->', ' → ') AS suspect, CASE cr.entity_type WHEN 'dependency_edge' THEN 'Connection' WHEN 'service' THEN 'Service' WHEN 'service_instance' THEN 'Instance' WHEN 'database' THEN 'Database' WHEN 'queue' THEN 'Queue' WHEN 'cache' THEN 'Cache' WHEN 'host' THEN 'Host' WHEN 'external' THEN 'Outside load' WHEN 'no_fault' THEN 'No fault' ELSE initcap(replace(cr.entity_type, '_', ' ')) END AS kind, CASE cr.fault_class WHEN 'dependency_unreachable' THEN 'Can''t reach a dependency' WHEN 'service_error' THEN 'Returning errors' WHEN 'conditional_service_error' THEN 'Returning errors for some requests' WHEN 'resource_saturation' THEN 'Running out of capacity' WHEN 'queue_lag' THEN 'Queue falling behind' WHEN 'database_lock' THEN 'Stuck on database locks' WHEN 'workload_spike' THEN 'Traffic spike' WHEN 'cache_failure' THEN 'Cache failing' WHEN 'memory_leak' THEN 'Leaking memory' WHEN 'garbage_collection_pause' THEN 'Pausing for garbage collection' WHEN 'readiness_failure' THEN 'Failing health checks' WHEN 'dependency_latency' THEN 'Slow to answer' WHEN 'conditional_dependency_latency' THEN 'Slow for some requests' WHEN 'no_fault' THEN 'No fault' ELSE initcap(replace(COALESCE(cr.fault_class, 'unknown'), '_', ' ')) END AS what_went_wrong, COALESCE(cr.probability, cr.score) AS score, CASE cr.confidence WHEN 'high' THEN 'Strong' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Likely' WHEN 'low' THEN 'Weak lead' ELSE 'Inconclusive' END AS trust, CASE WHEN o.delay IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN o.delay = 0 THEN 'Yes, changed first' ELSE CASE WHEN (o.delay) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (o.delay) < 60 THEN round(o.delay)::text || ' s' WHEN (o.delay) < 3600 THEN floor((o.delay) / 60)::text || ' min ' || round(mod((o.delay)::numeric, 60))::text || ' s' WHEN (o.delay) < 86400 THEN floor((o.delay) / 3600)::text || ' h ' || floor(mod((o.delay)::numeric, 3600) / 60)::text || ' min' ELSE floor((o.delay) / 86400)::text || ' days' END || ' later' END AS started_first, CASE WHEN cr.entity_type = 'dependency_edge' THEN split_part(cr.entity_id, '->', 1) ELSE cr.entity_id END AS trace_service FROM candidate_rankings cr LEFT JOIN onset o ON o.candidate_id = cr.id WHERE cr.incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) ORDER BY cr.rank LIMIT 15

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), top AS (SELECT * FROM candidate_rankings WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) ORDER BY rank LIMIT 1), ev AS (SELECT * FROM evidence_items WHERE candidate_id = (SELECT id FROM top)) SELECT verdict, finding, raw FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN evidence_type = 'temporal_precedence' THEN CASE WHEN value = 0 THEN 'For' ELSE 'Against' END WHEN evidence_type = 'topology_propagation' THEN CASE WHEN value >= 0.3 THEN 'For' ELSE 'Against' END WHEN evidence_type = 'dependency_health' THEN CASE WHEN value >= 0.05 THEN 'For' ELSE 'Against' END WHEN evidence_type = 'signal_anomaly' THEN 'For' ELSE 'Context' END AS verdict, CASE WHEN evidence_type = 'temporal_precedence' THEN CASE WHEN value = 0 THEN 'It was among the first things to change' ELSE 'It went bad ' || CASE WHEN (value) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (value) < 60 THEN round(value)::text || ' s' WHEN (value) < 3600 THEN floor((value) / 60)::text || ' min ' || round(mod((value)::numeric, 60))::text || ' s' WHEN (value) < 86400 THEN floor((value) / 3600)::text || ' h ' || floor(mod((value)::numeric, 3600) / 60)::text || ' min' ELSE floor((value) / 86400)::text || ' days' END || ' after the first anomaly' END WHEN evidence_type = 'topology_propagation' THEN CASE WHEN details ? 'covered' THEN 'It explains ' || jsonb_array_length(details->'covered')::text || ' of ' || (jsonb_array_length(details->'covered') + jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(details->'uncovered', '[]'::jsonb)))::text || ' affected components (' || round(100 * value)::text || '% of the spread)' ELSE 'It explains ' || round(100 * value)::text || '% of the spread' END WHEN evidence_type = 'dependency_health' THEN round(100 * value)::text || '% of calls on this link failed' || COALESCE(' (' || (details->>'request_count') || ' requests)', '') WHEN signal_name = 'latency_ms_p50' THEN 'Typical response time rose to ' || CASE WHEN (value) IS NULL THEN 'n/a' WHEN (value) >= 1000 THEN round(((value) / 1000)::numeric, 1)::text || ' s' WHEN (value) >= 10 THEN to_char(round((value)::numeric), 'FM999,999') || ' ms' ELSE round((value)::numeric, 1)::text || ' ms' END || ' (normal ' || CASE WHEN (baseline) IS NULL THEN 'n/a' WHEN (baseline) >= 1000 THEN round(((baseline) / 1000)::numeric, 1)::text || ' s' WHEN (baseline) >= 10 THEN to_char(round((baseline)::numeric), 'FM999,999') || ' ms' ELSE round((baseline)::numeric, 1)::text || ' ms' END || ')' WHEN signal_name = 'latency_ms_p95' THEN 'Slowest 5% of calls rose to ' || CASE WHEN (value) IS NULL THEN 'n/a' WHEN (value) >= 1000 THEN round(((value) / 1000)::numeric, 1)::text || ' s' WHEN (value) >= 10 THEN to_char(round((value)::numeric), 'FM999,999') || ' ms' ELSE round((value)::numeric, 1)::text || ' ms' END || ' (normal ' || CASE WHEN (baseline) IS NULL THEN 'n/a' WHEN (baseline) >= 1000 THEN round(((baseline) / 1000)::numeric, 1)::text || ' s' WHEN (baseline) >= 10 THEN to_char(round((baseline)::numeric), 'FM999,999') || ' ms' ELSE round((baseline)::numeric, 1)::text || ' ms' END || ')' WHEN signal_name = 'latency_ms_p99' THEN 'Slowest 1% of calls rose to ' || CASE WHEN (value) IS NULL THEN 'n/a' WHEN (value) >= 1000 THEN round(((value) / 1000)::numeric, 1)::text || ' s' WHEN (value) >= 10 THEN to_char(round((value)::numeric), 'FM999,999') || ' ms' ELSE round((value)::numeric, 1)::text || ' ms' END || ' (normal ' || CASE WHEN (baseline) IS NULL THEN 'n/a' WHEN (baseline) >= 1000 THEN round(((baseline) / 1000)::numeric, 1)::text || ' s' WHEN (baseline) >= 10 THEN to_char(round((baseline)::numeric), 'FM999,999') || ' ms' ELSE round((baseline)::numeric, 1)::text || ' ms' END || ')' WHEN signal_name = 'cpu_percent' THEN 'CPU use rose to ' || round(value::numeric, 1)::text || '% (normal ' || round(COALESCE(baseline, 0)::numeric, 1)::text || '%)' WHEN signal_name = 'memory_bytes' THEN 'Memory use rose to ' || round((value / 1048576)::numeric)::text || ' MB (normal ' || round((COALESCE(baseline, 0) / 1048576)::numeric)::text || ' MB)' WHEN signal_name = 'error_rate' THEN 'Error rate rose to ' || round(100 * value)::text || '% (normal ' || round(100 * COALESCE(baseline, 0))::text || '%)' ELSE COALESCE(summary, replace(COALESCE(signal_name, evidence_type), '_', ' ') || ' moved to ' || round(value::numeric, 2)::text || COALESCE(' (normal ' || round(baseline::numeric, 2)::text || ')', '')) END AS finding, COALESCE(signal_name, evidence_type) || ' = ' || round(value::numeric, 3)::text || COALESCE(' · baseline ' || round(baseline::numeric, 3)::text, '') || COALESCE(' · weight ' || round(contribution::numeric, 3)::text, '') AS raw, COALESCE(contribution, 0) AS weight FROM ev UNION ALL SELECT 'Caution', 'Normal values were still being learned (baseline 0), so these jumps may be overstated', 'cold-start baseline', -1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ev WHERE evidence_type = 'signal_anomaly' AND baseline = 0)) x ORDER BY CASE verdict WHEN 'For' THEN 0 WHEN 'Against' THEN 1 WHEN 'Caution' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, weight DESC

panels.description: When each component first looked abnormal, earliest first. Components that changed in the same 10-second window share a row.
panels.title: Who went wrong first

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), inc AS (SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM selected)), onset AS (SELECT candidate_id, min(value) AS delay FROM evidence_items WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) AND evidence_type = 'temporal_precedence' GROUP BY candidate_id), times AS (SELECT key AS entity, value::timestamptz AS at FROM inc, jsonb_each_text(inc.metadata->'anomaly_times')), first AS (SELECT min(at) AS t0 FROM times), sus AS (SELECT cr.rank, cr.entity_id, (SELECT started_at FROM inc) + make_interval(secs => o.delay) AS at FROM candidate_rankings cr JOIN onset o ON o.candidate_id = cr.id WHERE cr.incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) AND cr.rank <= 3) SELECT g.at AS started_at, CASE WHEN g.at = (SELECT t0 FROM first) THEN 'first' ELSE '+' || CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM g.at - (SELECT t0 FROM first))) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM g.at - (SELECT t0 FROM first))) < 60 THEN round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM g.at - (SELECT t0 FROM first)))::text || ' s' WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM g.at - (SELECT t0 FROM first))) < 3600 THEN floor((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM g.at - (SELECT t0 FROM first))) / 60)::text || ' min ' || round(mod((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM g.at - (SELECT t0 FROM first)))::numeric, 60))::text || ' s' WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM g.at - (SELECT t0 FROM first))) < 86400 THEN floor((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM g.at - (SELECT t0 FROM first))) / 3600)::text || ' h ' || floor(mod((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM g.at - (SELECT t0 FROM first)))::numeric, 3600) / 60)::text || ' min' ELSE floor((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM g.at - (SELECT t0 FROM first))) / 86400)::text || ' days' END END AS after_text, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM g.at - (SELECT t0 FROM first)) AS after_first, g.components, g.n AS how_many, concat_ws(' · ', CASE WHEN g.at = (SELECT t0 FROM first) THEN 'First to change' END, (SELECT string_agg('suspect #' || s.rank || ' ' || replace(s.entity_id, '->', ' → '), ', ' ORDER BY s.rank) FROM sus s WHERE s.at = g.at)) AS note FROM (SELECT at, string_agg(entity, ' · ' ORDER BY entity) AS components, count(*) AS n FROM times GROUP BY at) g ORDER BY g.at

panels.description: Only connections touching the top five suspects. Red = suspect #1, amber = other suspects. Node number = time after the first anomaly.
panels.title: Where the suspects sit

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), inc AS (SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM selected)), onset AS (SELECT candidate_id, min(value) AS delay FROM evidence_items WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) AND evidence_type = 'temporal_precedence' GROUP BY candidate_id), target AS (SELECT started_at - interval '5 minutes' AS from_at, COALESCE(ended_at, now()) + interval '2 minutes' AS to_at, run_id FROM inc), sus AS (SELECT cr.rank, cr.entity_id, cr.entity_type FROM candidate_rankings cr WHERE cr.incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) AND cr.rank <= 5), sus_svc AS (SELECT DISTINCT unnest(CASE WHEN entity_type = 'dependency_edge' THEN string_to_array(entity_id, '->') ELSE ARRAY[entity_id] END) AS svc FROM sus), latest_edges AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_service, target_service) source_service, target_service, request_count, error_rate, latency_ms_p95, protocol FROM dependency_edges, target WHERE bucket_start BETWEEN target.from_at AND target.to_at AND (target.run_id IS NULL OR dependency_edges.run_id = target.run_id) ORDER BY source_service, target_service, bucket_start DESC), shown AS (SELECT e.*, (SELECT min(rank) FROM sus WHERE sus.entity_id = e.source_service || '->' || e.target_service) AS edge_rank FROM latest_edges e WHERE e.source_service IN (SELECT svc FROM sus_svc) OR e.target_service IN (SELECT svc FROM sus_svc)), times AS (SELECT key AS entity, value::timestamptz AS at FROM inc, jsonb_each_text(inc.metadata->'anomaly_times')), nodes AS (SELECT source_service AS id FROM shown UNION SELECT target_service FROM shown) SELECT n.id, n.id AS title, CASE WHEN s.rank IS NOT NULL THEN 'suspect #' || s.rank WHEN t.at = (SELECT min(at) FROM times) THEN 'changed first' WHEN t.at IS NOT NULL THEN 'abnormal' ELSE 'normal' END AS subtitle, CASE WHEN t.at IS NULL THEN 'normal' ELSE '+' || CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.at - (SELECT min(at) FROM times))) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.at - (SELECT min(at) FROM times))) < 60 THEN round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.at - (SELECT min(at) FROM times)))::text || ' s' WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.at - (SELECT min(at) FROM times))) < 3600 THEN floor((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.at - (SELECT min(at) FROM times))) / 60)::text || ' min ' || round(mod((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.at - (SELECT min(at) FROM times)))::numeric, 60))::text || ' s' WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.at - (SELECT min(at) FROM times))) < 86400 THEN floor((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.at - (SELECT min(at) FROM times))) / 3600)::text || ' h ' || floor(mod((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.at - (SELECT min(at) FROM times)))::numeric, 3600) / 60)::text || ' min' ELSE floor((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.at - (SELECT min(at) FROM times))) / 86400)::text || ' days' END END AS mainstat, CASE WHEN s.rank = 1 THEN '#ff8f80' WHEN s.rank IS NOT NULL THEN '#f4c46a' WHEN t.at IS NOT NULL THEN '#a3adba' ELSE '#5fd19b' END AS color FROM nodes n LEFT JOIN (SELECT entity_id, min(rank) AS rank FROM sus WHERE entity_type <> 'dependency_edge' GROUP BY entity_id) s ON s.entity_id = n.id LEFT JOIN times t ON t.entity = n.id

WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), inc AS (SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM selected)), onset AS (SELECT candidate_id, min(value) AS delay FROM evidence_items WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) AND evidence_type = 'temporal_precedence' GROUP BY candidate_id), target AS (SELECT started_at - interval '5 minutes' AS from_at, COALESCE(ended_at, now()) + interval '2 minutes' AS to_at, run_id FROM inc), sus AS (SELECT cr.rank, cr.entity_id, cr.entity_type FROM candidate_rankings cr WHERE cr.incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) AND cr.rank <= 5), sus_svc AS (SELECT DISTINCT unnest(CASE WHEN entity_type = 'dependency_edge' THEN string_to_array(entity_id, '->') ELSE ARRAY[entity_id] END) AS svc FROM sus), latest_edges AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_service, target_service) source_service, target_service, request_count, error_rate, latency_ms_p95, protocol FROM dependency_edges, target WHERE bucket_start BETWEEN target.from_at AND target.to_at AND (target.run_id IS NULL OR dependency_edges.run_id = target.run_id) ORDER BY source_service, target_service, bucket_start DESC), shown AS (SELECT e.*, (SELECT min(rank) FROM sus WHERE sus.entity_id = e.source_service || '->' || e.target_service) AS edge_rank FROM latest_edges e WHERE e.source_service IN (SELECT svc FROM sus_svc) OR e.target_service IN (SELECT svc FROM sus_svc)), times AS (SELECT key AS entity, value::timestamptz AS at FROM inc, jsonb_each_text(inc.metadata->'anomaly_times')) SELECT source_service || '->' || target_service AS id, source_service AS source, target_service AS target, round(100 * error_rate)::text || '% failing' AS mainstat, COALESCE(round(latency_ms_p95)::text, 'n/a') || ' ms p95 · ' || request_count::text || ' calls' AS secondarystat, CASE WHEN edge_rank = 1 THEN '#ff8f80' WHEN edge_rank IS NOT NULL THEN '#f4c46a' WHEN error_rate >= 0.20 THEN '#c96a5f' WHEN error_rate >= 0.05 THEN '#b38a3e' ELSE '#4a5563' END AS color, CASE WHEN edge_rank IS NOT NULL THEN 4 ELSE 1 END AS thickness, protocol AS detail__protocol FROM shown

panels.description: Open incidents are always listed; resolved ones only within the time range. Pick one from the Incident menu at the top.
panels.title: Recent and open incidents

targets.rawSql: SELECT detected_at AS detected, CASE WHEN status IN ('open', 'monitoring') AND detected_at < now() - interval '1 day' THEN 'stale' ELSE status END AS status, severity, summary, replace(COALESCE(top_entity_id, 'awaiting analysis'), '->', ' → ') AS top_suspect, CASE top_fault_class WHEN 'dependency_unreachable' THEN 'Can''t reach a dependency' WHEN 'service_error' THEN 'Returning errors' WHEN 'conditional_service_error' THEN 'Returning errors for some requests' WHEN 'resource_saturation' THEN 'Running out of capacity' WHEN 'queue_lag' THEN 'Queue falling behind' WHEN 'database_lock' THEN 'Stuck on database locks' WHEN 'workload_spike' THEN 'Traffic spike' WHEN 'cache_failure' THEN 'Cache failing' WHEN 'memory_leak' THEN 'Leaking memory' WHEN 'garbage_collection_pause' THEN 'Pausing for garbage collection' WHEN 'readiness_failure' THEN 'Failing health checks' WHEN 'dependency_latency' THEN 'Slow to answer' WHEN 'conditional_dependency_latency' THEN 'Slow for some requests' WHEN 'no_fault' THEN 'No fault' ELSE initcap(replace(COALESCE(top_fault_class, 'unknown'), '_', ' ')) END AS failure_type, id::text AS id FROM v_incident_overview WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) OR status IN ('open', 'monitoring') ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Anomaly score for the 10 most unusual components around the incident. Above 3 is clearly abnormal. Early risers are clues, not proof.
panels.title: How unusual each component looked

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), target AS (SELECT started_at - interval '10 minutes' AS from_at, COALESCE(ended_at, now()) + interval '5 minutes' AS to_at, run_id FROM incidents WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM selected)), fb AS (SELECT bucket_start, entity_id, anomaly_score FROM feature_buckets, target WHERE bucket_start BETWEEN target.from_at AND target.to_at AND (target.run_id IS NULL OR feature_buckets.run_id = target.run_id)), keep AS (SELECT entity_id FROM fb GROUP BY entity_id HAVING max(anomaly_score) >= 3 ORDER BY max(anomaly_score) DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT bucket_start AS time, entity_id AS metric, anomaly_score AS value FROM fb WHERE entity_id IN (SELECT entity_id FROM keep) ORDER BY 1

defaults.noValue: No component crossed the abnormal line (score 3) in this window.

panels.description: Share of failing requests for the 10 components with the most errors around the incident.
panels.title: Error rate by component

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), target AS (SELECT started_at - interval '10 minutes' AS from_at, COALESCE(ended_at, now()) + interval '5 minutes' AS to_at, run_id FROM incidents WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM selected)), fb AS (SELECT bucket_start, entity_id, error_rate FROM feature_buckets, target WHERE bucket_start BETWEEN target.from_at AND target.to_at AND (target.run_id IS NULL OR feature_buckets.run_id = target.run_id)), keep AS (SELECT entity_id FROM fb GROUP BY entity_id HAVING max(error_rate) > 0 ORDER BY max(error_rate) DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT bucket_start AS time, entity_id AS metric, error_rate AS value FROM fb WHERE entity_id IN (SELECT entity_id FROM keep) ORDER BY 1

defaults.noValue: No component returned errors in this window.

panels.description: Age of the oldest of the newest span, metric and log. Under a minute is healthy.
panels.title: Data freshness

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(max(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - latest_at))), 0)::double precision AS value FROM v_telemetry_ingest_health WHERE signal IN ('spans', 'metrics', 'logs')

panels.description: Records the API could not normalise and quarantined, in the dashboard time range. The Signal table shows the all-time total.
panels.title: Rejected records · selected time range

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::double precision AS value FROM rejected_records WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)

panels.description: The model that scored the selected incident's suspects. heuristic-v1 is used automatically if a learned model cannot load.
panels.title: Ranking model in use

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT model_version FROM candidate_rankings WHERE incident_id = (SELECT id FROM selected) ORDER BY rank LIMIT 1), (SELECT name || ' · ' || version FROM model_versions WHERE status = 'champion' ORDER BY trained_at DESC LIMIT 1), 'heuristic-v1 (baseline)') AS model

panels.description: Collector-to-database flow by signal. A flat line may indicate an instrumentation, collector, or ingestion outage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', observed_at) AS time, 'spans' AS metric, count(*)::double precision AS value FROM spans WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('minute', observed_at) AS time, 'metrics' AS metric, count(*)::double precision AS value FROM metric_points WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('minute', received_at) AS time, 'logs' AS metric, count(*)::double precision AS value FROM log_records WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Telemetry arriving per minute

panels.description: Latest timestamp and lifetime count for each stored signal.

targets.rawSql: SELECT signal, records, latest_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - latest_at))::bigint AS age_seconds FROM v_telemetry_ingest_health ORDER BY signal

panels.title: Signals stored (all time)

panels.description: Champion/challenger registry and held-out evaluation metadata.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, version, model_kind AS architecture, status, trained_at AS trained, metrics::text AS evaluation FROM model_versions ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'champion' THEN 0 WHEN 'challenger' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, trained_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Model registry

panels.description: Reproducible labelled runs from the pinned OpenTelemetry Demo in the time range. Empty? Widen the time range, or capture one with scripts/run-demo-experiment.ps1.

targets.rawSql: SELECT er.started_at AS started, er.name AS run, er.source_version AS demo_version, left(er.source_sha, 12) AS commit, er.seed, er.workload, er.status, COALESCE(er.split, 'unassigned') AS dataset_split, count(fi.id) AS injected_faults FROM experiment_runs er LEFT JOIN fault_injections fi ON fi.run_id = er.id WHERE er.created_at >= $__timeFrom() GROUP BY er.id ORDER BY er.started_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

panels.title: Labelled experiment runs
